cases.check: Restart client, check identity, test authorization expiry and reconnect without duplicate writes.

Expiry remains untested.

cases.observation: Uncertain activation and pause resolved by state reads without replay or duplicate creation; synthetic original intent finished paused/private. Controlled same-key replay and version conflict remain untested.

cases.observation: Draft remained private. Public approval interception and visibility version-conflict paths remain untested.

cases.observation: Only one authenticated identity is established; two-account consent and isolation remain untested.
